mapper.select: SELECT * FROM llm_model_config WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM llm_model_config WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM llm_model_config WHERE is_default = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE llm_model_config SET is_default = 0, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE is_default = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM llm_model_config c JOIN llm_model_template t ON c.template_id = t.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC, c.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
